description: Void an issued invoice (reason required): releases source hours back to Approved and retains the immutable void record. IRREVERSIBLE. Call once with no token to preview; re-call with the returned confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: Id of the issued invoice to void.

reason.description: Required reason for voiding (recorded in the audit trail).

name: void_invoice
